item.title: Spartans finish fifth at Irontown Duals
item.description: CEDAR CITY – The Emery High School wrestling team traveled south over the weekend to compete at the Irontown Duals, squaring off against nine teams over two days of competition. The Spartans finished the weekend in fifth place overall. Host Canyon View claimed the team title, followed by Sierra Vista, Snow Canyon, Cedar City and Emery.
